items.quote: İlk yarı 10/10, adrenalin patlaması yaşatıp zevkten odanın içinde zıplattırıyor. Sonra ikinci yarı seni alıp bütün heyecanınla beraber 2,5 saat boyunca düşeceğin bir uçurumdan aşağı bırakıyor. Böyle bir deneyim istesem herhangi bir Galatasaray maçı da izleyebilirdim, en sevdiğim serinin yeni oyununu 4 yıl beklemeye gerek yoktu. Ya yine zamanları yetmedi ya da bütçeleri yetmedi, ama bize final diye izlettikleri şu garabetin bedeli olarak tüm emeği geçenler madenlerde çalıştırılmalı. Topluluğun aksine Kore savaşının sadece aksiyon olsun diye hikayeye eklenmesini doğru bulsam da Kuzey Kore fazla karikatürize edilmiş, yaptıkları aşırılıkların çoğunun gerçek hayatta da karşılığı olsa bile herkes çok koyu siyah ve beyaz olarak yazıldığı için göze batıyor. Oyun boyu bütün dünyanın peşinde koştuğu EMP'nin bu kadar kudretli ve bulunamaz bir silah gibi gösterilmesi komik olmuş, ismini bile söylemeyerek güya uzaylı teknolojisi havası yaratıyorlar. Karakterler özelinde Valeria benim için hikayeyi taşıyan tek karakterdi, önceki oyunlarda taşıyan Ghost ve Gaz'dan maalesef eser yok, adamları gördüğüm her saniye Hüsnü Çoban'a izletilen işkence gibiydi. Makarov'un iki oyundur uğradığı itibar suikastına da anlam verebilmiş değilim, Last Jedi'da Luke bile bu kadar aşağılanmamıştı. Archer ise tamamen facia, yeni bir MWIII vakası, Mads Mikkelsen gibi bir efsaneye rağmen unutmak isteyeceğim kadar berbat yazılmış bir karakter. Seriyi bitirme kararınızdan anlıyorum ki kaleminizin bu karakterlerin ağırlığını kaldıramadığını nihayet kabullendiniz. Her şeye rağmen ilk yarının iyiliği ikinci yarının kötülüğünden ağır basıyor, teşekkür ederim ve mümkünse bir daha görüşmeyelim Infinity Ward.

items.quote:
Actually a great game, but the multiplayer completely kills the funRating: 

3 / 10Review:

just need to honestly vent my frustration here. I was incredibly hyped for Modern Warfare 4. Especially because Black Ops 7 finally got matchmaking right again—there was that perfect mix of rounds where you dominated and rounds where you got clapped. That is exactly what CoD has always been **** what Infinity Ward is doing here is just way too extreme, and it completely ruins the multiplayer.

The biggest issue is the combination of the absolutely brutal skill-based matchmaking and the ridiculously fast time-to-kill . It feels like you die the second an enemy even looks at you. With this insanely fast TTK, you have absolutely zero chance to turn things around in a gunfight.

On top of that, the incredibly annoying perk balancing makes everything way more sweaty. You are forced to choose between the lesser of two evils: either you run Ninja without Tac-Sprint, which keeps you quiet but makes you crawl across the map like a snail, or you use Tac-Sprint and everyone on the map hears you coming from miles away. Meanwhile, in the high-skill lobbies, it feels like every single player is combining Ghost with Ninja. You can't hear them, you don't see them on the radar—it is just hardcore sweating at the most unfair level.

When the extreme matchmaking constantly throws you into lobbies where everyone plays like it's the world championship, the game becomes absolute hell. The moment you enjoy a single good round, you get punished instantly in the next match.

Why this game is completely driving me crazy right now:

• Zero room for error due to the TTK: Because you drop incredibly fast, passive corner camping is highly rewarded. Nobody dares to move normally across the map anymore.• Broken perk system: The Ghost and Ninja combo makes enemies practically invisible and silent, while you are forced to either sneak without Tac-Sprint or be extremely loud with it.

• You feel no progression: The SBMM pushes you right back down immediately, just to make sure you don't have too much fun.

• Team balancing is a joke: As a solo player, you get thrown into teams that stand absolutely no chance, just to act as a "counterweight" for the sweaty enemy team.

• It feels like actual work instead of relaxation: After three rounds, I am mentally completely drained because the constant sweating and instant deaths force you to be at 100% stress level every single **** campaign is great, but the multiplayer is currently a total buzzkill. If they don't tone down the matchmaking system soon and fix the perk balancing, I am completely done. It just doesn't make sense anymore.

items.quote:
Modern Warfare 4 is a really strong entry in the series. 

The campaign sticks to the franchise's classic strengths and is, in my opinion, the best Call of Duty campaign in years.

The multiplayer is solid too, especially if you enjoyed the Modern Warfare reboot games. It comes with many of the same strengths and weaknesses, but also a few welcome improvements. One of the best changes is that XP Tokens now only tick down during active matches instead of in real time.

I haven't spent much time with DMZ, but it's clear that the mode has been significantly expanded. If you're a fan of extraction-style gameplay, there's a lot more content and depth to dig into here.
